name: VCF Automation deployment failure triage request contract
product: VMware Cloud Foundation 9.1 - VCF Automation (VM Apps organization)

source.statement: This contract is NOT a published API specification. VCF Automation, the successor to vRealize / Aria Automation, has no machine-readable specification in the vmware/vcf-api-specs repository. Every operation below was derived by reading the VCF Automation xAPIs reference documentation published on the Broadcom Developer Portal at developer.broadcom.com/xapis. It is a hand-derived reading of human-facing reference pages and is authoritative only to the extent that those pages are, and only for the operations it names.
source.scope_note: Only the nine operations listed under 'operations' are covered. Any other VCF Automation endpoint is out of scope for this contract and must not be called.

conventions.optional_parameters: Optional query parameters and optional request body fields MUST be omitted entirely when they are not being used. They must never be sent as an empty string, as a null, as an empty list, or as an empty object. A parameter that carries no value carries no meaning to the service and changes the request wire shape.
conventions.undeclared_parameters: A request must not carry any query parameter or body field that this contract does not declare for that operation.
conventions.authorization: Every operation whose 'auth' is 'bearer' must carry the header 'Authorization: Bearer <access_token>', where <access_token> is the access_token returned by auth.token.exchange. The token exchange itself must not carry an Authorization header.
conventions.json_bodies: Operations whose request body encoding is application/json must send 'Content-Type: application/json'.
conventions.idempotent_reads: The GET operations in this contract are reads over a single request record; a caller has no reason to repeat one within a single triage run.

operations.summary: Exchange a VCF Automation API token (refresh token) for a short-lived bearer access token scoped to a tenant.

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.description: The VCF Automation API token issued to the caller.

200.notes: token_type is 'Bearer'; expires_in is a lifetime in seconds.

operations.summary: Returns a paginated list of deployments.

query_parameters.name: page
query_parameters.description: Zero-based page index (0..N).

query_parameters.name: size
query_parameters.description: The size of the page to be returned.

query_parameters.name: sort
query_parameters.description: Sorting criteria in the format: property,(asc|desc).

query_parameters.name: ids
query_parameters.description: A comma-separated list. Only deployments with these IDs will be included.

query_parameters.name: search
query_parameters.description: Given string should either be part of a searchable field in a deployment or one of the deployment's resources.

query_parameters.name: name
query_parameters.description: Results must have exactly this name.

query_parameters.name: status
query_parameters.description: A comma-separated list. Results must be associated with one of these statuses.

query_parameters.name: projects
query_parameters.description: A comma-separated list. Results must be associated with one of these project IDs.

query_parameters.name: resourceTypes
query_parameters.description: A comma-separated list. Results must be associated with one of these resourceType names.

query_parameters.name: cloudAccounts
query_parameters.description: A comma-separated list. Results must be associated with one of these cloud accounts.

query_parameters.name: cloudTypes
query_parameters.description: A comma-separated list. Results must be associated with one of these endpoint types.

query_parameters.name: requestedBy
query_parameters.description: A comma-separated list. Results must be associated with one of these requesters.

query_parameters.name: ownedBy
query_parameters.description: A comma-separated list. Results must be associated with one of these owners.

query_parameters.name: tags
query_parameters.description: A comma-separated list. Results must be associated with one of these tags.

query_parameters.name: createdAt
query_parameters.description: Comma-separated ISO 8601 start and end dates; both are optional.

query_parameters.name: expiresAt
query_parameters.description: Comma-separated ISO 8601 start and end dates; both are optional.

query_parameters.name: lastUpdatedAt
query_parameters.description: Comma-separated ISO 8601 start and end dates; both are optional.

query_parameters.name: expandResources
query_parameters.description: The 'resources' field of each resulting deployment will be retrieved.

query_parameters.name: expandLastRequest
query_parameters.description: Expands deployment last request.

query_parameters.name: expandProject
query_parameters.description: The 'project' field of each resulting deployment will be retrieved.

query_parameters.name: expand
query_parameters.description: The expanded details of the requested comma-separated objects.

query_parameters.name: lastRequestStatus
query_parameters.description: A comma-separated list of last request statuses.

query_parameters.name: deleted
query_parameters.description: Retrieves only soft-deleted deployments that have not yet been completely deleted.

query_parameters.name: $top
query_parameters.description: Number of records to return.

query_parameters.name: $skip
query_parameters.description: Number of records to skip.

query_parameters.name: $orderby
query_parameters.description: Sorting criteria in the format: property (asc|desc).

query_parameters.name: $filter
query_parameters.description: A subset of records that satisfy the given predicate expression. Supports startswith, toupper, substringof and eq.

200.notes: Deployment.name and Deployment.type-bearing fields aside, every Deployment field except name is optional; a server may return a projection.

operations.summary: Returns the requests for the deployment.

query_parameters.name: deleted
query_parameters.description: Retrieves soft-deleted requests that have not yet been completely removed.

query_parameters.name: inprogressRequests
query_parameters.description: Retrieves currently in-progress requests; ignored if false.

query_parameters.name: search
query_parameters.description: Filters by searchable fields in deployment-level requests.

query_parameters.name: page
query_parameters.description: Zero-based page index (minimum 0).

query_parameters.name: size
query_parameters.description: The size of the page to be returned (minimum 1).

query_parameters.name: sort
query_parameters.description: Sorting criteria in the format: property,(asc|desc).

query_parameters.name: $top
query_parameters.description: Number of records to return.

query_parameters.name: $skip
query_parameters.description: Number of records to skip.

query_parameters.name: $orderby
query_parameters.description: Sorting criteria in the format: property (asc|desc).

200.notes: Every Request field except completedTasks, createdAt, name, requestedBy and totalTasks is optional, so this listing may return a lighter projection than requests.get. Read the full record with requests.get when fields such as inputs or resourceIds are needed.

operations.summary: Returns the request with the given ID.

200.notes: 'details' is a longer user-friendly summary of the request. It is a summary only and is not a diagnosis; the cause of a failure lives in the request's events and event logs.

operations.summary: Returns all the events for a request.

query_parameters.name: page
query_parameters.description: Zero-based page index (0..N).

query_parameters.name: size
query_parameters.description: The size of the page to be returned.

query_parameters.name: sort
query_parameters.description: Sorting criteria in the format: property,(asc|desc).

200.notes: An event carries no status field. Whether a particular event succeeded or failed is only visible in that event's logs, and only events whose hasLogs is true have logs to read.

operations.summary: Returns the logs for an event.

query_parameters.name: sinceRow
query_parameters.description: A positive row number from which to show logs. Omit it to read the log from the beginning.

200.description: A slice of event log entries.
200.notes: Entries are ordered by rownum ascending. The final entry of a complete log has eof true.

404.description: Not found. Returned when the event has no logs, that is when the event's hasLogs is false.

operations.summary: Cancel can be submitted on in-progress requests and dismiss can be submitted on failed requests.

query_parameters.name: action
query_parameters.description: The operation to perform on the request. 'cancel' applies to in-progress requests; 'dismiss' applies to failed requests. The values are lowercase.

request_body.notes: This operation takes no request body. Send no body at all.

200.description: Accepted; no response payload is defined.

409.description: Conflict; the request is not in a state that permits the action.

operations.summary: Submit a deployment action request (a day-2 action against an existing deployment).

fields.name: actionId
fields.description: The id of the action to perform.

fields.name: inputs
fields.description: Inputs for the action. Omit this field when the action takes no inputs; do not send an empty object.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Reason for requesting a day-2 operation. Omit this field when no reason is supplied; do not send an empty string or a null.
